$comment: Entry schema for contributes.customEditors (process plugins, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_custom_editors.go: viewId must name one of this plugin's contributes.views; a wildcard pattern needs a literal extension (containing '.') of at least 2 characters after its last wildcard, '..' and empty segments are rejected; a priority 'default' editor may not match any contract sensitiveFilenames; access 'readWrite' requires the workspace.write capability; titles are single-line.
description: Custom editors: open matching project files in one of this plugin's views through the host document bridge (bounded reads; atomic, conflict-checked saves for readWrite).

viewId.description: Id of one of this plugin's contributes.views; the view renders the document.

items.description: Case-insensitive glob (** any path, * and ? within one segment); matched against the basename, or against the project-relative path when it contains '/'. Examples: *.drawio, docs/**/*.bpmn, Dockerfile.

priority.description: default opens matching files with this editor after a one-time user confirmation; option (default) only offers it under Open With.
